notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact Phyrexian creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a nontoken artifact Phyrexian creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the Phyrexian dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the Phyrexian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When the Phyrexian enters the battlefield, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Incubator, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
